evals.prompt: Generate FlowMem memory for this Python library project
evals.expected_output: Creates .flowmem/ with at minimum: structure/modules.mmd, structure/classes.mmd, quality/debt.mmd, and INDEX.md
expectations: At least one chart in structure/ layer
At least one chart in quality/ layer
All .mmd files have FlowMem metadata comment on line 2
All .mmd files have valid Mermaid syntax (no syntax errors)
INDEX.md lists all generated charts with layer and method columns

evals.prompt: Generate FlowMem memory for this Node.js application
evals.expected_output: Creates .flowmem/ with flowchart (npm deps), classDiagram (TS exports), and behavior charts
expectations: scan_packages.js output is used for module graph
scan_ts_exports.js output is used for class diagram

evals.expected_output: Reads and presents .flowmem/INDEX.md in a readable format
expectations: Does not load every .mmd file upfront

evals.prompt: How does authentication work in this project?
evals.expected_output: Loads behavior layer charts related to auth, reads them, and answers using specific node names from the chart
expectations: References specific participants/nodes from the chart in the answer

evals.expected_output: Runs refresh_all.sh and reports which script-backed charts were updated
expectations: Lists charts that may need regeneration
Updates last-updated dates for regenerated charts
